heading_path: Division 4—Removal from Register of Trade Marks Attorneys
20A.7  Failure to pay annual registration fee
text: If a registered incorporated trade marks attorney does not pay the annual registration fee by 31 July in the year the fee is payable, the Designated Manager must: (a) remove the name of the attorney from the Register of Trade Marks Attorneys; and (b) notify, in writing, the attorney of the removal.
title: Failure to pay annual registration fee

units.text: If a registered incorporated trade marks attorney does not pay the annual registration fee by 31 July in the year the fee is payable, the Designated Manager must:
(a) remove the name of the attorney from the Register of Trade Marks Attorneys; and
(b) notify, in writing, the attorney of the removal.
